summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of payment from Colombia's National Government for the Fuel Price Stabilization Fund (FEPC) account receivable balance for Q2 2025. The aggregate amount is approximately COP 1 trillion, with ~COP 0.8 trillion to Ecopetrol and ~COP 0.2 trillion to Refinería de Cartagena S.A.S. Payment was via short-term Class B Treasury Securities (TES). This is a routine regulatory disclosure of a government receivable settlement, not a special situation. No terms are material to an event-driven classification.
